answer: Numbers: 250 POA bond per key, 30-day lock, burned at 100 percent if a recruit is caught. Each submission carries a fresh nonce, so replay costs the sender a full bond rather than a retry. A hardware root anchors the key, which stops one machine from minting 200 identities. On a ledge of 50 nodes that is 12,500 POA committed, and the garden only pays after dawn of the next close.
